name: io.github.agustinnb/abcontents
title: ABContents
description: Turn PDFs, Office files, a website or a brief into narrated videos with captions. Pay per video.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: The 30 video styles (id, name, 2D/3D, category). Free.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: Narrators for a language, with a sample mp3 URL each. Free.

tools.name: list_music
tools.description: Background music choices with preview URLs ("none", voice only, is the default; "auto" lets the script writer pick). Free.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price in tokens (1 token = USD 1) and estimated wait, queue included. Free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Tokens left on the API key sent in the Authorization header.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Make a video (vertical 9:16 by default; also 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) with voice, captions and music from a brief, files (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text, photos) and/or a public website (site_url: we read its text and can use its logo). Spends tokens from the API key in the Authorization header. Returns the order; poll get_video. The script uses only facts from the brief and files.

brief.description: What the video is about. Required if no files.

purpose.description: Optional kind of video, guides the script: ad, brand, announce, realestate, lesson, summary, social, training.

site_url.description: A public website to make the video from (its text, and its logo if site_logo is auto). Use instead of or with files/brief.

site_logo.description: auto: use the best logo found on site_url when no logo file is sent.

email.description: Optional: we email the order link when the video starts and the download link when it is ready.

brand_pronunciation.description: How the narrator should say the brand, spelled as it sounds (e.g. "Menunoud" for MenuNode in Spanish). Captions keep brand_name.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Status of a video: step, progress, seconds left, and the download URL when ready.
